tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Roman family name Antonius; the etymology is uncertain, often linked to 'priceless' or to a root meaning 'flower'. Its root is Latin Antonius. Saint Anthony of Egypt; Saint Anthony of Padua. Anthony is a Latin name meaning “Priceless; invaluable; (also) flourishing”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
